DIALECT AND SCOPE
Afrikaans, a West Germanic language derived from Dutch, spoken across South Africa and Namibia with regional varieties including Cape, Orange River, and Eastern Border Afrikaans. Project audio reflects everyday speech with code-switching to English common in urban areas.
